_comment: Centrifugo v5 config aligned with this project's realtime provider implementation (server/services/realtime/centrifugo.ts). Secrets MUST be supplied via environment variables (CENTRIFUGO_TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET_KEY, CENTRIFUGO_API_KEY, CENTRIFUGO_ALLOWED_ORIGINS). Do NOT hard-code them here.
_comment_auth: HS256 connection JWTs are issued by the backend (CentrifugoDriver.issueConnectionToken). The HMAC secret is provided via CENTRIFUGO_TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET_KEY env var.
_comment_api: Server-to-server HTTP API. Used by the backend for health checks (method=info) and optional broadcast (method=publish). API key provided via CENTRIFUGO_API_KEY env var.
_comment_origins: Multi-tenant SaaS: backend (/api/realtime/connect + /subscribe) enforces per-workspace origin allow-list against workspace_domains. Centrifugo is the transport layer only — keep allowed_origins permissive ['*'] so any customer domain can connect without a redeploy. The backend is the SOLE authorization gatekeeper.
_comment_channels: Channel namespace 'ws' matches the channel pattern issued by buildChannelName(workspaceId, conversationId) → 'ws:{workspace_id}:conv:{conversation_id}'. Subscribe tokens are required (private channels), presence/history enabled to support typing/presence capabilities.

namespaces._comment: Visitor live presence (vp:v2:{workspace_id}:{session_id}). Membership IS the presence signal; only the backend may read it with the API key, so allow_presence_for_client MUST stay false. Must match CENTRIFUGO_NAMESPACES in the compose files.
namespaces.name: vp

_comment_client: Anonymous clients are NOT allowed; every connection must present a valid HS256 token issued by the backend. Subject ttl matches the default token_ttl_seconds (300s).
_comment_websocket: WebSocket transport. Compression on, ping/pong intervals tuned for mobile widget connections.
_comment_admin: Admin UI is OFF by default. To enable for debugging, set admin: true and provide CENTRIFUGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD + CENTRIFUGO_ADMIN_SECRET via env, then expose /admin behind your reverse proxy with HTTP basic auth or IP allowlist.
_comment_health: Used by the docker healthcheck and by Coolify.
_comment_engine: Single-node memory engine is sufficient for this deployment scale. For HA / multi-node, switch to 'redis' and add redis_address.
